BibleBack Translation

Hub

Job

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka baseen ni Hub, sabeka seini ne guhuren meyitenged te etew ne matareng ne impasalerep te mangune-kune ne karereetan—migpatey ka langun ne anak din, nenaawe ka langun ne karatuan din, wey inggingumaan pad iya man-e sikandin te mangune-kune ne dalu. Ne due pitu ne baad te guhuren te seini ne baseen. Ne pinaahi te sika ne me guhuren, impanengneng te talagsulat ke nekey ka inggeram ni Hub wey te me alukuy rin meyitenged te sika ne me karereetan. Ne ka impurtanti ne baad te guhuren, iyan sika se paahi te Manama te peg-uyan te keet-etawan din. Ne nataman, migpapitew mismu ka Manama ki Hub.

The document of Hub, this (is) one story concerning a righteous/sensible person who caused_to_suffered_disaster of terrible destruction—all his children died(pl), all his wealth disappeared(pl), and terrible sickness indeed also came to him. And there are seven portions of stories of this reading_document. And by_means of that stories, the writer informed what Hub and his friends felt concerning of that destructions. And the important portion of the story, (is) the means of God (MS Manama) leading his people. And then, God reveals himself to Hub.

Te marani pad te an-anayan te seini ne baseen, ingkahiyan ni Meibulan ka Manama te kene ne meupiya ka peg-uyan te keet-etawan din ne egdasahan din ka me matareng. Purisu diye egpangkus te iyan naan de egpuunan ne eggimu te matareng ka me etew tenged te dasag. Ne kenad e ne egpuun te pusung dan ka peggimu ran te matareng. Ne seini iya ka ingkahi ni Meibulan meyitenged ki Hub. Purisu intuhutan te Manama si Meibulan ne eg-el-elehan ka pegkamatinumanen ni Hub ke egpabulus-bulus naan pad sikandin ne matareng ke eg-antus sikandin.

Near the beginning of this reading_document, Satan tells God that leading his people is not good that he rewards those who are righteous. So the result is the people were doing right just for the rewards. And their doing right is not from their heart anymore. And this is indeed what he tells about Hub. That's why God allows Satan to test Hub's faithfulness if he will remain righteous when he suffers.

Ne pinaahi te kinaraan ne pegpalintutuu, impasabut te me alukuy ni Hub ne mig-antus sikandin tenged su nakasale sikandin. Piru para ki Hub, kene perem ne eleg ne eg-antus sikandin te sika ne legpad su matareng ma sikandin ne etew. Ware din nasabut ke mania te intuhutan te Manama ne eggingumaan sikandin te makaliyas-liyas ne dalu te matareng ma sikandin ne etew. Purisu inhanggat din ka Manama ne eggendiye sikandan te hukumanan. Ne minsan pad due, ware naawei ka pegpalintutuu ni Hub, piru igkeupii rin ne eg-ileen sikandin ne matareng te Manama, wey egkaangken din ded ka kabantug isip matareng ne etew.

And by_means of old believing/faith, the friends of Hub explained that he was_suffering because he had_sinned. But for Hub, it wasn't [wishfully] correct that he suffered with that punishment because he (was) a righteous/sensible person. He didn't understand why God permitted that terrifying sickness came_to him when he (was) a righteous/sensible person. Therefore he challenged God that they will_go to the court. And despite that, the faith/believing by Hub wasn't lost, but he wanted that he be_recognized as righteous/sensible by God, and (that) he could_be_accept honor as a righteous/sensible person.

Ware tabaka te Manama ka me inse ni Hub. Piru inggehet ded te Manama ka pegpalintutuu ni Hub, pinaahi te geem wey katuenan din. Ne in-ila ni Hub ne labew ne matagseb ka Manama, duma te pegpariralem din, wey migbuyu sikandin te pasaylu te nenallalag din puun te langet din.

God didn't answer the questions by Hub. But God confirmed the faith/believing by Hub, by_means of his power and knowledge. And Hub recognized that God is more wise, along_with his humility, and he requested forgiveness for what_ he _said from his anger.

Ne ka katamanan te seini ne baseen, migpanengneng ne impalibed ded ki Hub ka meupiya ne keugpe din, wey migsubla pad sikandin ne matubung du te dengan. Ne impangehetan te Manama ka me alukuy ni Hub, su ware ma sikandan nakanengneng ke mania te mig-antus si Hub. Si Hub de ka nakasabut ne madmaresen pad ka Manama du te kinaraan ne pegpalintutuu.

And the ending of this document, informed that Hub's good living was_made_to_return to him, and he (was) more prosperous than before. And God scolded at the friends of Hub, because they didn't know why Hub suffered. Only Hub understood that God (is) stronger than the old faith/believing.

Ka meupiya ne peg-ugpe ni Hub

The good living of Hub

11 Due etew ne egngaranan ki Hub ne mig-ugpe diye te Us. Matareng sikandin, wey ware igkarew-ey. Due pegkaaldek din te Manama wey kene sikandin eggimu te mareet. 2 Due pitu ne anak din ne me lukes wey tatelu ne malitan. 3 Ne due pitu ne libu (7,000) ne karniru rin, tatelu ne libu (3,000) ne kamil, lalimma ne gatus (500) ne paris ne baka, wey lalimma ne gatus (500) ne beyan ne asnu. Ne susuluhi degma ka me suluhuanen din, purisu sikandin ka subla ne meyaman ne etew te langun ne nangugpe diye dapit te igsile. 4 Ka me anak din ne lukes, egmasubsubaley re ne egsahakeen diye te tagse baley ran mismu, wey egmanginggaten dan ka me atebey ran eyew eglagpu kandan te egkekeen wey eg-iinum. 5 Ne emun ke egpekeimpus e ka me anak din ne egsahakeen, igpeumew rin e sikandan eyew te pegpanubad para te pegmatulus kandan eyew egkaayun ded man-e sikandan ne eg-apil te pegsimba te Manama, su migsuman-suman ma sikandin ne kema ke nakasale ka me anak din wey nenakalalag te mareet diye te Manama. Egselem-selem sikandin eg-enew, wey egtutung te igpanubad ne ayam, wey eg-atulen din egpanubari ka me anak din. Ne layun de iya sikandin egpanubad para te me anak din.

11 There was a person named Hub who lived there at Us. He was sensible/righteous, and could_be_scolded_for nothing. He had fear of God and he didn't do evil. 2 There were seven male children of his and three female. 3 And there were seven thousand (7,000) sheep of his, three thousand (3,000) camels, five hundred (500) pairs of cattle, and five hundred (500) female donkeys. And his servants were also very_many, therefore he (was) the richest person of all who lived there in the east. 4 His male children, just took_turns(pl) at making_a_feast there at each of their own houses, and they invited(pl) their sisters in_order join them in eating and drinking. 5 And when his children finished feasting, he would_send_for them in_order for sacrificing to purify them so that they are still possible to join in worshiping God, because he thought what if his children had_sinned and spoken evil about God. He would rise early, and burn a domestic_animal sacrifice, and he sacrificed for all his children. And he indeed always just sacrificed for his children.

Ka peg-apul ni Meibulan te katareng ni Hub

The denying by Satan of the righteousness of Hub

6 [xr]Sabeka ne aldew, miglibulung ka me panalihan diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey diye degma si Meibulan[fn] te kalibulungan. 7 Ne mig-inse ka Magbebaye ki Meibulan, “Hendei ka migpuun?”

6 [xr]One day, the angels gathered there in_front of Lord God, and Satan[fn] (MS Meibulan) was there also at the gathering. 7 And the Lord asked Satan, “Where have you(sg) come_from?”

Ne migtabak si Meibulan, “Migleug-leug a diye te kalibutan.”8 Ne migkahi e man-e ka Magbebaye, “Ew. Ne nakabantey ke naa te suluhuanen ku ne si Hub? Ware egpekeiling kandin diye te ampew te tane—matareng sikandin wey ware igkarew-ey, wey due pegkaaldek din keddi wey kene eggimu te mareet.”

And Satan answered, “I wandered_over the world.”8 And the Lord said again, “Oh. And did_ you(sg) _take_notice of my servant Hub? There's_none like him there on top of the earth—he's righteous/sensible and can_be_scolded_for nothing, and he has fear of me and doesn't do evil.”

9 Ne migtabak si Meibulan, “Uya le re iya su due egkaangey rin keykew. 10 Impariyu nu sikandan se taltalaanak te langun ne karereetan wey ka langun ne kandin. Impanalanginan nu ka langun ne inggimu rin, wey migmasalig amana ka me ayam din. 11 Kema dereeti[fn] nu ka langun ne diye te kandin—pitawen ta ke kene sikandin egpanlalag te mareet keykew.”

9 And Satan answered, “Yes indeed because he can_get (stuff) from_you(sg). 10 You(sg) keep_away all destruction from them including his family and all that's his. You(sg) bless everything that he does, and his domestic_animals have_increased very_much. 11 What_if you(sg) destroy[fn] all that he has—let us(incl) look if he doesn't speak(pl) evil of/to you(sg).”

12 Ne migkahi ka Magbebaye, “Uya, egtuhutan ku sikeykew ne eggimu te minsan nekey ne igkeupii nu diye te kandin, piru kene nu re sikandin menuwa.” Seeye naa, mig-awe e si Meibulan diye te tangkaan te Manama.

12 And the Lord said, “Yes, I permit you(sg) to do whatever you(sg) desire to him, but don't(sg) harm him.” So then, Satan left from the front of God.

Ka pegdereet ni Meibulan te karatuan wey te me anak ni Hub

The destruction by Satan of the wealth and children of Hub

13 Sabeka ne aldew, taheed te migsahakeen ka me anak ni Hub diye te baley te kinakakayan ne anak din, 14 due etew ne migginguma diye ki Hub ne migpangguhud ne migkahi, “Taheed te migdaru key te me baka nu diye te kamet, wey migpepanabtab te me asnu, 15 sahuhune ne due nanginguma ne me matig-Sibiya wey impangimatayan dan e ka me duma ku ne me suluhuanen nu, wey impanuyuk dan e ka me ayam nu. Ne sikeddi naan de iya ka nakapallahuy. Sikan naa ka nekeendini a ka egguhud keykew.”

13 One day, while the children of Hub feasted there at the house of his eldest child, 14 there_was a person that arrived to Hub that storied that said, “While we(excl) were in the field plowing with your(sg) cows, and the donkeys were grazing, 15 suddenly there_were the (ones) from_Sibiya that arrived(pl) and my companions your(sg) servants were_killed by_them, and your(sg) domestic_animals were led_away(pl) by them. And only just me indeed was_able_to_flee. That's why I came_here to story you(sg).”

16 Te sasangan pad ka etew ne egpangguhud, duen e man-e senge-etew ne migginguma wey migpangguhud ne migkahi, “Nasuhat te kilat ka me karniru nu wey ka me suluhuanen nu. Sikeddi naan de iya ka nasame, sikan naa ka nekeendini a ka egguhud keykew.”

16 While the person was still storying, there_was also a person that arrived and storied that said, “Your(sg) sheep and your(sg) servants were_struck by lightning. And only just me remained, that's why I came_here to story you(sg).”

17 Te sasangan pad degma ka etew ne egpangguhud, duen e man-e senge-etew ne migginguma wey migpangguhud ne migkahi, “Inlusuran key te me matig-Kaldiya ne tatelu ne punduk, wey impanuyuk dan e ka me kamil, wey impangimatayan dan pad man-e ka me duma ku ne me suluhuanen nu, wey sikeddi naan de iya ka nakapallahuy, sikan naa ka nekeendini a ka egguhud keykew.”

17 While the person was also still storying, there_was again a person that arrived and storied that said, “We(excl) were invaded by three groups from_Kaldiya, and they led_away(pl) the camels, and they also killed my companions your(sg) servants, and only just me was_able_to_flee, that's why I came_here to story you(sg).”

18 Te sasangan pad degma ka etew ne egpangguhud, duen e man-e senge-etew ne migginguma wey migpangguhud ne migkahi, “Taheed te migmanliblibulung ka me anak nu ne egsahakeen diye te baley te kinakakayan ne anak nu, 19 sahuhune ne due nenekali ne kalamag puun te disirtu, wey nasuhat te seeye ne kalamag ka baley te anak nu. Nalundus ka baley wey neneutunan e sikandan langun wey nammatey e. Sikeddi de iya ka nasame, sikan naa ka nekeendini a ka egguhud keykew.”

18 While the person was also storying, there_was again a person that arrived and storied that said, “While your(sg) children were meeting(pl) feasting there at the house of your(sg) eldest child, 19 suddenly there_was very_strong wind from the desert, and the house of your(sg) child was hit by that wind. The house got_demolished and they all were_trapped_underneath and died. Only just me indeed remained, that's why I came_here to story you(sg).”

20 Seeye de iya, migsasindeg si Hub wey inggisi din ka kumbale din wey in-abuluhan din ka ulu rin. Ne miglangkeb sikandin diye te tane wey migsimba te Manama. 21 Migkahi sikandin, “Miglesut a ne ware kukumbaleen puun te eanakan te iney ku, wey eglibed a diye te tane ne ware ded kukumbaleen. Ka Magbebaye ne Manama ka egbehey te langun, wey sikandin ded ka eggawi. Egdayanen ka ngaran din.”

20 So then, Hub stood and he tore his clothes and he shaved his head. And he lay_face_down there on the ground and worshiped God. 21 He said, “I was_born without clothing from the womb of my mother, and I will_return to the ground just without clothing. The Lord God (is) the (one who) gives everything, and just he retrieves. Praise his name.”

22 Ne minsan ke neiling e dutu, ware ded iya man-e nakasale si Hub wey ware miglalag te mareet diye te Manama.

22 And even if it's like that, Hub didn't indeed sin and didn't speak evil to God.

Ka tatelu ne alukuy ni Hub

The three friends of Hub

11 Ne due tatelu ne alukuy ni Hub ne egngaranan ki Ilipas ne matig-Timan, ki Bildad ne matig-Suwa, wey ki Supar ne matig-Naama. Te pegkarineg dan te masumpit ne neula-ula ni Hub, nenekeg-uyun sikandan ne eggendiyaan si Hub eyew eg-unungan wey egliwangen dan sikandin. 12 Te egpalinggumaan e sikandan, nakita ran e sikandin piru ware dan neileyi. Te namelmelehan dan e ne sikandin bes seeye, migpandalawit e sikandan wey inggisi dan ka kumbale dan wey imbukbukan dan te alinepung ka me ulu ran. 13 Ne in-unungan dan e sikandin ka migpinpinnuu diye te tane te pitu ne aldew wey pitu ne marusilem. Ne ware dan lalahi sikandin su nakita ran ne subla ne masumpit ka egkeula-ula rin.

11 And there were three friends of Hub named Ilipas from_Timan, Bildad from_Suwa, and Supar from_Naama. Upon their hearing about the incredible fate/experience of Hub, they agreed_together to go_there to Hub in_order to sympathy and comfort him. 12 When they were_approaching, they saw him but they didn't recognize (him). When they saw_clearly that it was him [surprise], they wailed and tore their clothes and sprinkled dust on their heads. 13 And they were_sympathy with him sitting there on the ground for (LIT inside) seven days and seven nights. And they didn't speak to him because they saw that his experience was extremely_bad.

221 And Ilipas from_Timan answered,

2 [xr]“Duen naa etew, minsan ka subla ne matagseb ne egpakabulig te Manama?

2 [xr]“Is_there a person/people, even the very wise that can_help God?

3 Egpakapahale naa te Maresen ne Manama ka pegkamatareng nu?

3 Can_ your(sg) being_sensible/righteous _please the Strong/Powerful God?

Duen naa egkakuwa rin puun keykew ke ware igpakarew-ey keykew?

Is_there (something) that he will_get from you(sg) if there's_nothing to_scold_ you(sg) _for?

4 Insaparan ka te Manama wey in-el-elehan,

4 You(sg) were_scolded by God and tested,

kene ne tenged su migtahud ka kandin,

not because you(sg) respected him,

5 ke kene, tenged te suble e ka mareet ne hinimuwan nu,

5 but rather, due to your(sg) very bad actions,

wey ware sanggel te peggimu nu te kene ne me meupiya

and no stopping of your(sg) doing of not good

6 su ingkuwa nu ma ka me kumbale te me karumaan nu

6 because you(sg) took the clothes of your(sg) relatives

isip gerentiya te utang dan keykew.

as guarantee of their debt to_you(sg).

Purisu warad igsaluub dan.

Therefore they have_nothing to_wear.

7 Ware nu peinuma ka nammaraan,

7 You(sg) didn't give_a_drink to the thirsty,

wey ware nu pakeena ka inggutasan.

and you(sg) didn't feed the hungry.

8 Inggamit nu ka keseg wey katenged nu,

8 You(sg) used your(sg) strength and authority,

eyew te peg-angken te tane te lein ne me etew.

in_order for receiving the land of other people.

9 Ke due me balu ne egpabulig keykew, egpeulien nu re due sikandan ne ware egkeuyan.

9 If there_are widows that request_help from_you(sg), you(sg) just send_ them _home without (anything) to_take(pl).

Ne impanakawan wey indeeg-deeg nu pad iya man-e ka me ilu.

And you(sg) also steal_from and indeed oppress orphans.

10 Purisu nalingutan ka kuntee te me sahilut,

10 Therefore you(sg) are_surrounded now/today by the snare_traps,

wey sahuhune ne iyan egdapit keykew ka liyas.

and suddenly it's cowardness that favors you(sg).

11 Nalingutan ka te marusilem,

11 You(sg) are_surrounded by darkness,

wey kene kad e egpakakita,

and you(sg) can_ no_longer _see,

wey egkaalep kad te baggiyu.

and you(sg) will_drown in a flood.

12 “Diye te kinaribabawan ne baad te langit ka Manama,

12 “God (is) there in the highest portion of heaven/sky,

wey subla pad ne matikang te me bituen.

and much higher than stars.

13 Purisu migkahi ka,

13 Therefore you(sg) say,

‘Ware nakanengneng ka Manama te inggimu ku.

‘God doesn't know what_ I _did.

Egmenuwen din naa te eggukum kanta te nabunbunan ma sikandin te makepal ne gapun?’

How will_ he _judge us(incl) when he's covered by thick cloud?’

14 Migsuman-suman ka ne kene sikandin egpakakita,

14 You(sg) think that he can't see,

su neeletan sikandin te makepal ne gapun,

because he's blocked by thick cloud,

taheed te eggiphipanew sikandin diye te eletanan te tane wey langit.

while he walks_around there at the boundary of earth and sky/heaven.

15 Egpabulus-bulus ke bes pad eg-ikul te hinimuwan dengan

15 Will_ you(sg) _continue [surprise] following/imitating the actions

te me makasesale?

of sinners before/long_ago?

16 Minsan kene pad ne eleg ne timpu ne egpatey sikandan,

16 Even_though (it's) not the correct time for them to_die(pl),

egpanganlasen e sikandan iling te pabunsuranan te baley ne nalened te baggiyu.

they will_be_washed_away like the foundation of a house that's drowned in a flood.

17 Ingkekahiyan dan ka Maresen ne Manama,

17 They told the Strong/Powerful God,

‘Engkeri key!

‘Leave us(excl)!

Nekey naa ka egkeyimu nu kanami?’

What can_ you(sg) _do to_us(excl)?’

18 Piru minsan pad due, nasi de iya sikandan matubunga te Manama.

18 But despite that, instead they were_ just indeed _prospered by God.

Purisu maddiyu te suman-suman ku ka minsan nekey ne igpanulu te me makasesale.

Therefore what ever (is) teaching of sinners (is) far from my thinking.

19 Ne egkengahale wey egmangngingisi ka me matareng wey ka me etew ne ware sale

19 And the righteous/sensible (ones) and the people without sin(s) will_be_happy(pl) and will_laugh(pl)

ke egkakita ran e ka karereetan te me makasesale.

when they see the destruction of sinners.

20 Ne egkekahi sikandan,

20 And they will_say,

‘Egkahule iya ka me kuntere ta,

‘Our(incl) enemies will_ indeed _be_exterminated,

wey egkengasilaban ka egkengasame ne karatuan dan.’

and what_remains(pl) of their wealth will_be_burned_up(pl).’

21 Ne kuntee Hub, paruma-ruma ka te Manama,

21 And now Hub, go_along_with(sg) God,

eyew egmalinawen ka,

so_that you(sg) will_be_peaceful,

wey egpanalanginan ka nikandin.

and you(sg) will_be_blessed by_him.

22 Dawata nu ka me panulu te Manama keykew,

22 Accept(sg) the teachings of God to_you(sg),

wey itines nu te pusung nu ka me lalag din.

and store_away(sg) his words in your(sg) heart.

23 Libed ka diye te Maresen ne Manama duma te pegpariralem,

23 Return(sg) to the Strong/Powerful God along_with humility,

wey ipeeneng-eneng nud ka mareet ne himu due te pamilya nu.

and stop(sg) the bad actions there to your(sg) family.

24 Isipa nu ka bulawan ne egpuun te Upir ne iling naan de te alinepung,

24 Consider(sg) the gold from Upir as just like dust,

wey ka neelin ne bulawan iling naan de te me batu diye te beuhan.

and the pure/genuine gold just like stones there in a creek.

25 Ne iyan nud e karatuan ka Amana ne Maresen ne Manama

25 And (make) the Strong/Powerful God your(sg) wealth

iling te bulawan wey mahal ne pelata.

like gold and expensive silver.

26 Ne egkahale ka tenged te Amana ne Maresen ne Manama,

26 And you(sg) will_be_happy due to the very Strong/Powerful God,

wey sikandin naan de ka egleng-ahen nu.

and (it's) just him that_ you(sg) _will_look_up_to.

27 Ne emun eg-ampu ka kandin,

27 And if you(sg) pray to_him,

egtabaken ka nikandin.

you(sg) will_be_answered by_him.

Ne tumana nu ka me panaad nu diye te kandin.

And obey(sg) your(sg) promises there to him.

28 Ne eglampus ka te minsan nekey ne egplanuwen nu ne eggimuwen,

28 And you(sg) will_prosper in what ever you(sg) plan to_do,

wey egmalayag ka egbayaan nu.

and where_ you(sg) _pass_through will_be_lit_up.

29 Ne igpariralem te Manama ka me hambuhen,

29 And the proud(pl) will_be_humbled by God,

piru egpangabangan din ka me mapariralemen.

but he will_rescue the humble(pl).

30 Egpangabangan ka te Manama ke ware sale nu,

30 You(sg) will_be_rescued by God if you(sg) have_no sin,

su egpangabangan te Manama ka me etew ne matareng.”

because the righteous/sensible people will_be_rescued by God.”

Ka tabak ni Hub ki Ilipas

The answer by Hub to Ilipas

231 Ne migtabak si Hub,

231 And Hub answered,

2 “Taman kuntee amana pad ka pegsagsahukul ku te Manama.

2 “Until now my complaining to God (is) still very (ongoing).

Impaantus a nikandin patamtamani minsan pad te me pegdeg-uy ku.

I was_made_to_suffer by_him without_ending even (despite) my wincing_in_pain.

3 Ke nakanengneng e re perem ke hendei ku sikandin egkakita,

3 If I had_known [wishfully] where I could_find him,

ke egkeendiyaan ku re perem sikandin te ugpaanan din,

if I could_go_there [wishfully] to his living_place,

4 igguhud ku iya mule kandin ka me pegsagsahukul,

4 on_the_contrary I would_ indeed _story my complaints,

wey me katarengan ku.

and my defenses.

5 Egkeupian a ne egpakarineg te tabak din,

5 I want to_hear his answer,

wey egkeupian a ne egpakasabut te eglalahen din.

and I want to be_able_to_understand what_ he _says.

6 Eggamiten naa te Manama ka karesen din te egpakig-apul keddi?

6 Will_ God _use his greatness/power for arguing_with me?

Kene! Egpamminehen a iya nikandin.

No! I would_be_listened_to indeed by_him.

7 Kena a ne limbungen ne etew,

7 I'm not a cheating/deceiving person,

purisu egpakapangatarengan a diye te Manama,

therefore I'm able_to_give_a_defense there to God,

wey egbehayan a te ware egtamanan ne kaligwangan.

and I will_be_given freedom without ending.

8 Purisu miggendiya ad te igsile wey iglineb,

8 Therefore I went_there to the east and west,

piru ware ku nakita diye ka Manama.

but I couldn't find God there.

9 Miggendiya ad te igkakawanan wey igkahibang ne balabahan,

9 I went_there to the north and south (LIT right and left side),

piru ware ku red man-e sikandin nakita.

but I still didn't find him again.

10 Piru nakanengneng ka Manama ke nekey ka inggimu ku.

10 But God knows what_ I _do.

Ne emun egkeel-elehan ad nikandin,

And if I'm tested by_him,

egkanengnengan din e ne telek a iling te bulawan.

he will_find_out that I'm pure like gold.

11 Mapahetpet ka peg-ikul ku te dalan ne in-alam te Manama,

11 My following of the path chosen by God (was) active/energetic,

wey wara ad iya migsuwey-suwey.

and I never indeed deviated.

12 Intuman ku layun ka me suhu din,

12 I always obeyed his commands,

wey intines ku kayi te pusung ku ka me lalag din.

and I stored_away his words here in my heart.

13 “Piru kene egkaalin-halin ka suman-suman din,

13 “But his thinking doesn't keep_changing,

wey ware minsan hentew ne egpakabalabag ke nekey ka igkeupii rin ne eggimuwen.

and no one can_block what he wants to_do.

14 Purisu egtumanen din ke nekey ka implanu rin para keddi,

14 Therefore he will_obey what (ever) he planned for me,

wey masulug pad ka planu rin keddi.

and his plan(s) for_me (are) many.

15 Purisu naaldek a diye te tangkaan din.

15 Therefore I am_afraid there in front of_him.

Ne minsan egsumsumanen ku re seeye, egkaalatan a iya.

And even if I just think_about that, I am_terrified indeed.

16 Inggimu a iya te Maresen ne Manama ne egmahuye

16 Indeed I was_made weak by the Strong/Powerful God

wey egkalilliyasan.

and afraid.

17 Piru wara a migpeeneng-eneng

17 But I didn't silence

minsan hendue te nabunbunan a te subla ne delem.”

even_though it_was_like I was_covered with extremely gloom.”

Ka pegsagsahukul ni Hub tenged te me makasesale

The complaining by Hub concerning sinners

241 Ne migkahi e man-e si Hub,

241 And again Hub said,

“Mania te ware migteil te timpu ka Maresen ne Manama eyew te peggukum te me makasesale,

“Why didn't God arrange a time in_order for judging sinners,

eyew egkakita te langun ne mig-ila kandin, ka me peggukum din?

in_order that his judging could_be_seen, by all who recognize him?

2 “Egpangensihen e te me etew ka me tuus te eletanan te tane, eyew egmaluag ka tane dan;

2 “The signs for boundary(s) for land are_moved_aside(pl) by people, so_that their land become_wide;

egmanakew sikandan te me ayam,

they steal(pl) domestic_animals,

wey igmalemung dan e te me ayam dan.

and they put_ (them) _in_with(pl) their domestic_animals.

3 Ne egpanuyuken dan ka me asnu te me ilu,

3 And they lead_away(pl) the donkeys of orphans,

wey ka me baka te me balu,

and the cows of widows,

isip gerentiya te me utang.

as guarantee of debts.

4 In-awaan dan te katenged ka egkengaayu-ayu,

4 They removed authority from the poor(pl),

purisu napehes e sikandan ne egpangeles.

therefore they are_persuaded to hide(pl).

5 Purisu egmekeiling e te me leew ne asnu diye te disirtu,

5 Therefore like(pl) wild donkeys there in the desert,

ka egkengaayu-ayu ne egmamitew te egkakeen para te me anak dan.

(are) the poor(pl) that search(pl) for food for their children.

6 Egmanggaani sikandan diye te me kamet ne kene ne kandan,

6 They harvest(pl) there in fields that are not theirs,

wey egmakilalew te me behas te paras diye te parasan te maddeet ne me etew.

and glean the fruits of grapevines there in vineyard(s) of bad/evil(pl) people.

7 Egmangibat sikandan te intiru ne marusilem ne egkengaaghagsilan

7 They lie_down(pl) for the entire night feeling_cold(pl)

su ware me uulesenen,

because there's_no blankets,

wey ware pad iya man-e eleg ne kumbale dan.

and their clothe(s) are indeed again not yet correct.

8 Egkengeuranan sikandan diye te me bubungan,

8 They are_rained_on(pl) there in the mountains,

wey diye naan de ubag egmangelung te me pahang

and there (they) just [embarrassedly] take_shelter in the cliffs

su ware man e me ugpaanan dan.

because they have_no [emphasis] living_places.

9 “Egpanguen te me makasesale ka dereisek pad ne me anak te balu ne malitan,

9 “The sinners take(pl) small children of female widow(s),

wey ka me anak te egkengaayu-ayu isip gerentiya te utang.

and the children of the poor(pl) as guarantee for debt.

10 Egmangip-hipanew ka egkengaayu-ayu ne egmalawas tenged su ware me kumbale dan;

10 The poor(pl) walk_around(pl) naked(pl) because they have_no clothes;

egmanggut-gutasan de due sikandan

they are_ just _hungry(pl)

ka egmababeen te nenahaani ne trigu.

the (ones) carrying harvested wheat.

11 Egmakekelesen sikandan te me ulibu eyew egpekeyimu te mentika,

11 They wring_out olives in_order to_become cooking_oil,

wey behas te paras eyew egpekeyimu te binu,

and fruit of grapevine(s) in_order to_become wine,

piru mig-antus sikandan te pegkammareyi.

but they suffer with thirst.

12 Ne egkarineg diye te siyudad ka pegdeg-uy te egpamatey e,

12 And the wincing_in_pain of (those) dying can_be_heard there in the city,

wey ka pegpangananey te nenapalian,

and the wounded(pl) requesting_help,

piru minsan pad dutu, warad en iya miglinga-linga ka Manama.

but despite that, God doesn't indeed pay_attention.

13 “Due me etew ne egkeepes te malayag;

13 “There_are people who dislike light/brightness;

ware sikandan mig-ikul te malayag,

they don't follow/imitate the light/brightness,

wey nasi sikandan migsuwey.

and instead they deviate.

14 Te kene pad egsile ka aldew, eg-enew e ka talaggimatey,

14 Before the sun rises, the murderer gets_up,

eyew te pegpangimatey te egkengaayu-ayu wey te egkengaware-ware,

in_order to kill the poor and destitute,

wey te marusilem, egpanakew man-e sikandin.

and at night, he steals again.

15 Ne ka talagpanlibug degma,

15 And the adulterer also,

egtetahad te egkasagkup,

waits for dusk,

wey egbunbunan din ka ulaula rin, eyew kene sikandin egkeilaan.

and he covers his face, so_that he won't be_recognized.

16 Te timpu te marusilem,

16 At night time,

egpanlekat te alabat te me baley ka me takawen,

thieves open_up the wall(s) of houses,

wey te maaldew, egmangeles sikandan,

and at daytime, they hide(pl),

wey ware sikandan nakanengneng ke mamenu ka malayag.

and they don't know what_ the light/brightness _is.

17 Egkengaaldek sikandan te layag te aldew,

17 They are_afraid(pl) of the light of the sun,

piru ware liyas dan te delem.

but they have_no cowardness of darkness.

18 “Migkahi kew te eg-anlasen te baggiyu ka me makasesale,

18 “You(pl) say that sinners are_swept_away by a flood,

wey egdilusen te Manama ka tane dan

and their land is_cursed by God

purisu kenad sikandan egpangendiye te parasan dan.

therefore they will_ no_longer _go_there to their vineyard(s).

19 Ne iling te apiyew ne egkatunew te keinit te gulabung,

19 And like hail that melts in the heat of a drought,

egkaawe degma puun te tane ka me makasesale.

the sinners will_ also _be_removed from the land.

20 Ne warad e egpakasuman-suman kandan minsan ka iney ran.

20 And no (one) will_think_about/remember them even their mother(s).

Ne egkekeenen e sikandan te me liwati,

And they will_be_eaten by worms,

wey egkareetan iya sikandan iling te kayu ne impeled.

and they will_ indeed _be_destroyed like tree(s) that are_felled.

21 Egkeyitabu iya seini su indeeg-deeg dan ma ka me balu,

21 This indeed will_happen because they oppress widows,

wey ware dan upiani ka me malitan ne kene egmakaanak.

and they don't do_good to women that haven't borne_children.

22 Piru egguleen te Manama ka maddesen pinaahi te geem din.

22 But the strong/powerful(pl) are_exterminated by God by_means of his power.

Eggimuwen din sika wey egpamatey ka me makasesale.

He does that and the sinners will_die(pl).

23 Egkaayun ne egtuhutan te Manama ka me makasesale ne eg-ugpe ne ware karereetan,

23 It's_possible that God will_permit sinners to_live without destruction,

piru eg-iipaten din sikandan te langun ne eggimuwen dan.

but he spies on everything they do.

24 Egkabantug sikandan te malepet de ne timpu,

24 They will_be_honored for just a short time,

wey egkataman, egkaawe e iling te bulak ne egkengatahak

and finally, be_removed like a flower that's dropped(pl)

wey iling te tagdey te paley ne eggaaniyen.

and like heads of rice that are_harvested.

25 Ke kene ne eleg ka ingkahi ku,

25 If what_ I _said isn't true/correct,

hentew naa ka egpakapamalehet ne mig-uubat a,

who then can_prove that I'm lying,

wey hentew ka egpakakahi ne seyyup ka ingkahi ku?”

and who can_say that what_ I _said is (a) mistake?”

Ka tabak ni Bildad

The answer by Bildad

251 Ne migtabak si Bildad ne matig-Suwa,

251 And Bildad from_Suwa answered,

2 “Maresen ka Manama,

2 “God (is) strong/powerful,

wey eleg ne igkaaldek te langun;

and correct for being_feared by all;

inggimu rin ne malinawen ka migharian din diye te langit.

he made his kingdom peaceful there in heaven/sky.

3 Duen naa egpakaseel te me sundalu te Manama?

3 Is there (anyone who) can_count the soldiers of God?

Duen naa inged ne ware nateng-awi te kalayag din?

Is there (any) place that's not lit_up by his light?

4 Duen naa etew ne matareng diye te tangkaan te Manama?

4 Is there (any) person that's righteous/sensible there in front of God?

Duen naa neetew ne malinis?

Is there (anyone) born that's clean?

5 Te pegtengteng din te bulan wey me bituen, kene pad ne mallayag diye te kandin.

5 At his looking at the moon and stars, (they're) still not yet bright to him.

6 Sikan naa degma, te pegtengteng din te me etew,

6 Therefore also, at his looking_at people,

iling de sikandan te me iyas wey liwati ne kene ne impurtanti.”

they are just like maggots and worm(s) that are not important.”

Ka tabak ni Hub

The answer by Hub

261 Ne migtabak si Hub,

261 And Hub answered,

2 “Migsuman-suman ke buwa ne nakabulig ka keddi te egkaayu-ayu wey mahuye?

2 “Maybe you(sg) thought that you(sg) were_able_to_help me who's poor and weak?

3 Migsuman-suman ke buwa ne nakatambag ka keddi te ware katagseb,

3 Maybe you(sg) thought that you(sg) can_advise me (who's) without wisdom,

pinaahi te dakel ne katagseb nu?

by_means of your(sg) big wisdom?

4 Hendei migpuun sika se impanlalag nu?

4 Where is_ that that_ you(sg) _said _from?

Hentew ne panisingan ka migpanulu keykew ne iglalag sika?

Which spirit taught you(sg) to_say that?

5 Impangelkel te liyas ka me pamulingan te me minatey,

5 The spirits of corpses tremble with cowardness,

ne nangugpe diye te diralem te weyig ne diralem te tane.

that live there below the water below the ground.

6 Amana namayanpayan diye te Manama ka inged te me minatey,

6 The place of corpses is_ very _transparent there to God,

wey ware egpakabunbun due puun te pegtengteng din.

and nothing can_cover it from his looking_at (it).

7 Intekul te Manama ka langit diye te igkahibang ne balabahan

7 The sky/heaven was_flattened_out by God there in the north (LIT left side)

wey intahu din ka kalibutan ne ware neunturan diye te aw-awangan.

and he placed the world without something_to_sit_on in the atmosphere/sky.

8 Imbugsung din ka uran te makepal ne gapun,

8 He wrapped the rain in thick cloud,

piru ware nawahey ka gapun minsan mabehat ka uran.

but the cloud doesn't disintegrate even_though the rain (is) heavy.

9 Imbunbunan din te makepal ne gapun ka migtimman ne bulan.[fn]

9 He covered the full moon[fn] with thick cloud.

10 Ne impegsuwey rin ka malayag wey marusilem

10 And he separated the light and dark

pinaahi te pegtahu te malibusen ne badlis diye te kulit te dahat.

by_means of putting round line on the surface of the sea.

11 Ke egbebentaanan te Manama te egdereet ka me sungkaleg te langit,

11 If God plans to destroy the posts of the sky/heaven,

egpangelkelen seini te pegkaaldek iling te etew.

they tremble with fear like a person.

12 Ne pinaahi te geem din impapeeneng-eneng din ka dahat,

12 And by_means of his power he causes_ the sea _to_calm/quiet,

wey pinaahi te katagseb din, intalu rin ka salimbaweng ne si Rahab.

and by_means of his wisdom, he defeated the sea_monster Rahab.

13 Ne pinaahi te peggeheyinawa rin,

13 And by_means of his breathing,

migmaawang ka langit,

the sky/heaven was_cleared,

wey pinaahi te kampilan din,

and by_means of his sword,

inggimatayan din ka salimbaweng ne egduldulihis.

he killed the sea_monster that's twisting (its body).

14 Piru deisek de iya sika ne baad te immangimu rin,

14 But that's just indeed a small portion of what_ he _did(pl),

wey me lanawes de ka narineg ta puun kandin.

and (it was) just noise/sound_of_the_wind that_ we(incl) _heard from him.

Ware egpakatirew te karesen te Manama.”

No (one) can_test the strength/power of God.”

271 Ne migpabulus-bulus si Hub ka migkahi,

271 And Hub continued saying,

2 “Igsaad ku te manekal wey Maresen ne Manama

2 “I promise by the strong/living and Strong/Powerful God

ne ware migbehey keddi te eleg ne peggukum,

that didn't give me correct judging,

wey ka migbayad-bayad keddi,

and the (one) persecuted me,

3 ne taman te manekal e pad,

3 that while I'm still alive/strong,

wey taman te duen pad geyinawa ku ne egpuun te Manama,

and while I still have breath that's from God,

4 kena ad iya eglalag te mareet,

4 I indeed won't speak bad/evil,

wey kena ad iya eg-uubat.

and indeed I won't lie.

Ka pegkalangeti ni Ilihu

The angry of Ilihu

321 Ne warad migtabak ka tatelu ne alukuy ni Hub, su impeuteng din ma iya ne ware sale ne neyimu rin. 2 Piru due etew ne egngaranan ki Ilihu ne ware iya mule nakatigkel te langet din tenged su ware ma iya mig-angken si Hub ne nakasale sikandin, wey nasi migsendit te Manama.

321 And the three friends of Hub no_longer answered, because he indeed got_across that he had_done no mistake. 2 But there_was a person named Ilihu that indeed couldn't control his anger because Hub wouldn't accept that he had_sinned, and instead blamed God.

Anak si Ilihu ni Barakil ne kabuhalan ni Bus ne kabuhalan ni Ram.3 Nalangetan man-e sikandin te tatelu ne alukuy ni Hub, su warad ma sikandan nakatabak ki Hub, wey nekeiling e nasi te iyan e due sale te Manama. 4 Tenged te egkaari-hari si Ilihu, intaharan din pad ne egpekeimpus ka tatelu ne eglalag ne human pad sikandin migbunsud ka eglalag ki Hub. 5 Te pegkakita rin ne ware nakatabak ka tatelu ne alukuy ni Hub, amana sikandin nalangeti.

Ilihu (was) the child of Barakil a descendant of Bus a descendant of Ram.3 He was_angry also at the three friends of Hub, because they couldn't answer Hub, and instead it was_like there_was a mistake of/by God. 4 Due to Ilihu being_younger, he waited until the three had_finished speaking before he began speaking to Hub. 5 When he saw that the three friends of Hub couldn't answer, he became_ very _angry.

IGKAPITU NE BAAD: Katamanan ne lalag

SEVENTH PART: Last speech

(42:7-17)

(42:7-17)

Ka pegtuman enni Ilipas, Bildad, wey ni Supar te Manama

The obeying to God by Ilipas, Bildad, and Supar

7 Te nekeimpus e ka Magbebaye ne Manama ne migpakiglalag ki Hub, ingkahiyan din e si Ilipas ne matig-Timan, “Nabelu a keykew wey te daruwa ne alukuy nu su ware kew nahud miglalag te kamalehetan meyitenged keddi, iling te inlalag ni Hub ne suluhuanen ku. 8 Purisu kuwa kew te pitu ne turu ne baka, wey pitu degma ne lukesan ne karniru. Ne uyana niyu naa seini ki Hub eyew igpanubad niyu ne egtutungen. Si Hub ka eg-ampu para kaniyu wey egtabaken ku ka peg-ampu din, wey kene kud sikaniyu eglegparan te eleg perem te me keungelan niyu pinaahi te peglalag niyu te kene ne eleg meyitenged keddi; kene mule ne iling te inlalag ni Hub ne suluhuanen ku.”

7 When the Lord God had_finished speaking_with Hub, he spoke_to Ilipas from_Timan, “I am_angry at you(sg) and at your(sg) two friends because you(sg) didn't actually speak the truth concerning me, like what_ Hub my servant _said. 8 Therefore get(pl) seven bull cows, and also seven male sheep. And take (pl) these to Hub in_order_for you(pl) to_sacrifice a burnt offering. Hub (is) the (one who) will_pray for you(sg) and I will_answer his praying, and I won't punish you(pl) with the correct [wishfully] for your(pl) foolishness by_means of your(pl) speaking (what's) not correct concerning me; not on_the_contrary like what_ Hub my servant _said.”

9 Ne intuman ni Ilipas, ni Bildad, wey ni Supar ka insuhu kandan te Magbebaye. Ne intabak te Magbebaye ka peg-ampu ni Hub.

9 And Ilipas, Bildad, and Supar obeyed what_was_commanded to_them by the Lord. And the Lord answered the praying by Hub.

Ka pegpanalanginan ki Hub te dubli pad du te an-anayan

The double blessing of Hub than at_first

10 [xr]Ne nataman, te nakaampu e si Hub para te me alukuy rin, imparatu e man-e sikandin te Magbebaye; imbehayan sikandin te Magbebaye te dubli pad du te naangken din dengan. 11 Ne migsahakeen si Hub para te langun ne suled din, me atebey rin, wey para te me alukuy rin dengan. Ne migpangendiye langun sikandan te baley rin ka migtambung te sahakeen. Ne inliliwang dan si Hub tenged te impeula-ula te Magbebaye kandin. Ne migbehey te seleppi wey bulawan ne ariyus ka tagse sabeka kandan.

10 [xr]And then, when Hub prayed for his friends, he was_made_wealthy again by the Lord; he was_given double by Lord compared to what_ he _had_received before. 11 And Hub feasted for all his siblings/cousins, his sisters, and for all his friends before. And they all went_there to his house to_attend the feast. And they comforted Hub due to what_ Lord _had_destined for_him. And each one of_them gave money and gold earring.

12 Impanalanginan te Magbebaye ka mewuri ne me aldew te umul ni Hub, subla pad te an-anayan ne naangken din. Nakaangken sikandin te sapulu wey hep-at ne libu (14,000) ne karniru, hen-em ne libu (6,000) ne kamil, daruwa ne libu (2,000) ne baka, wey sabeka ne libu (1,000) ne beyan ne asnu. 13 Ne nakaanak pad man-e si Hub te pitu ne lukes wey tatelu ne malitan. 14 Ingngaranan din ka panganey ne malitan ki Himima ka kakey, Kisiya ka hari, wey Kirin-Hapuk ka kinaariyan.[fn] 15 Ware me malitan ne iling kateles te me anak ni Hub te intiru ne kalibutan. Ne impamehayan degma sikandan ni Hub te me karatuan ne egkapanunud dan iling te me maama ran. 16 Ne puun te nakalibed e ka karatuan ni Hub, neuyag pad sikandin taman te 140 ne leg-un, wey nakakita pad sikandin te me apu din te buel. 17 Ne migpatey e sikandin ne buyag e amana.

12 The later days of the life of Hub were_blessed by Lord, more than what_ he _had_received at_first. He received fourteen thousand (14,000) sheep, six thousand (6,000) camels, two thousand (2,000) cows, and one thousand (1,000) female donkeys. 13 And Hub gave_birth to another seven males and three females. 14 He named the eldest female Himima, the younger_sibling Kisiya, and the youngest Kirin-Hapuk.[fn] 15 There_were_no females as beautiful as the children of Hub in the entire world. And they were_ also _give wealth by Hub that they could_inherit like their brothers. 16 And from when the wealth of Hub returned, he lived another 140 years, and he saw his great-grandchildren (LIT grandchildren of the knee). 17 And he died very old.
